Let me create a summary of the implementation. The feature is fully implemented and tested. Here's what was completed:

## Implementation Summary

### ✅ CLI Changes (`packages/frai-cli/src/index.ts`)
- Added `threshold?: string[]` to `EvalOptions` interface
- Added `--threshold <metric>=<min>` option to eval command (repeatable with accumulator pattern)
- Added `parseThreshold()` helper to parse and validate threshold strings
- Added `getValidMetricIds()` helper to extract available metric IDs from evaluations
- Updated `runEvalCommand()` to:
  - Parse and validate thresholds before running evaluations (fail-fast with exit 2)
  - Pass parsed thresholds to `generateReport()`
  - Check report.passed status and exit 1 if thresholds failed, 0 if passed

### ✅ SDK Changes (`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.js`)
- Updated `generateReport()` to accept optional `thresholds` parameter
- Calculates threshold results for each threshold:
  - Finds matching metric by ID
  - Extracts score (null if missing)
  - Determines pass/fail: `score !== null && score >= min`
- Returns report with:
  - `passed`: true if all thresholds pass, false if any fail (true if no thresholds)
  - `thresholds`: array of threshold result objects `{metric, min, score, passed}`

### ✅ Reporting Changes (`packages/frai-core/src/eval/reporters.js`)
- Updated `toMarkdown()` to add "Thresholds" section:
  - Shows overall status (PASS/FAIL)
  - Lists per-threshold status with metric, min, score, and result
  - Displays null scores as "n/a"
  - Only shows section if thresholds were evaluated
- JSON format automatically includes `passed` and `thresholds` fields

### ✅ Testing (`packages/frai-core/src/eval/index.test.js`)
Added 8 comprehensive test cases:
- ✅ Report includes passed and empty thresholds by default
- ✅ Evaluates thresholds and passes when all metrics meet minimum
- ✅ Fails threshold when metric score is below minimum
- ✅ Fails threshold when metric has no score
- ✅ Evaluates multiple thresholds correctly
- ✅ Fails overall when any single threshold fails
- ✅ Includes thresholds in markdown report

### ✅ Documentation (`packages/frai-cli/README.md`)
Updated `frai eval` section with new option:
```
--threshold <metric>=<min>  Threshold for metric (e.g., exact_match=0.8). 
                            Can be used multiple times. Valid metrics: 
                            exact_match, toxicity, length_variance
```

### ✅ End-to-End Testing Verified
- **Exit 0**: Thresholds pass
- **Exit 1**: Thresholds fail (report still written)
- **Exit 2**: Validation errors with helpful messages listing valid metrics
- **Markdown format**: Shows Thresholds section with overall and per-metric status
- **JSON format**: Includes `passed` and `thresholds` fields
- **Backward compatible**: Without `--threshold`, behavior unchanged

### Key Features
✅ Multiple thresholds supported (repeatable `--threshold` option)
✅ Metrics without scores fail their thresholds
✅ Clear error messages with valid metric IDs for unknown metrics
✅ Validates format and range (0-1) before running evaluations
✅ Report always written, even on threshold failure
✅ Works with custom metrics passed to `runEvaluations`
✅ Fully backward compatible
